title: Dashboard/Alerts card scroll height is a shared constant, not per-component CSS
answers: Where is the height of the Recent/Starred/Most-used dashboard list set
How many rows show before scrolling in the Dashboards card
Why does the loading skeleton height match the loaded dashboard list height
body:
The fixed scroll-area height for the DashboardTabs and Alerts cards on the redesigned homepage is defined once as DASHBOARD_TABS_SCROLL_HEIGHT_REDESIGN (currently 180, ~3 rows) in types.ts, and DASHBOARD_TABS_SCROLL_HEIGHT_DEFAULT (256) for the legacy layout.
This constant is consumed by DashboardTabs' loading skeleton and the real tab content so they stay pixel-identical and don't shift on load.
Changing the visible row count means editing this one constant, not per-tab inline styles.
